gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.
costs less = is less expensive; 'considerably' keeps the degree.

gaps.lead: Journalists allege that the mayor accepted bribes.
gaps.explanation: 'They allege that he did' becomes 'he is alleged to have done' — passive reporting.

gaps.lead: Living in the city is new to her.
gaps.sentence: She is not ___ in the city.
gaps.explanation: 'Be used to living' = be accustomed to (note the gerund).

gaps.lead: People claim that this herbal tea cures colds.
gaps.explanation: X is claimed to + infinitive = people claim X does.

gaps.lead: 'I never wrote that review,' the chef insisted.
